row.team_price_text: Starter: $57/mo billed annually (up to 3 team members, flat)
row.evidence: ChartMogul's pricing page lists team-member limits, REST API/MCP access and 'SOC 2 Type II certified. GDPR compliant.' under Enterprise & security, but no SSO or SCIM; team members are invited by email and deactivated manually by Admins and Owners.
row.notes: None by absence: no SAML/OIDC SSO or SCIM on the pricing page (incl. the Enterprise & security rows), the help centre (270-URL sitemap and search for sso/saml/scim/okta return nothing), the security page (2FA only) or the developer reference (184-URL sitemap: sources, customers, CRM and billing data, no team-member resource). Sign-in is email/password or 'Sign in with Google' (social, not SSO). Pricing scales with tracked ARR (slider); flat plan prices shown at the default $450k ARR position: Starter $57/mo and Pro $99/mo billed annually, Enterprise from $19,900/yr, so per-user fields are null. Manual deactivation logs the member out immediately, removes their API keys and keeps shared data.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited team members. SSO and SCIM are not listed in any plan row.

plans.name: Starter
plans.price_text: $57 per month, billed annually (at $450k ARR slider default)
plans.notes: Up to 3 team members; price scales with ARR tracked. SSO and SCIM are not listed in any plan row.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: $99 per month, billed annually (at $450k ARR slider default)
plans.notes: Unlimited team members. SSO and SCIM are not listed in any plan row.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: SSO and SCIM are not listed in any plan row.

scim.notes: No SCIM documentation found anywhere on chartmogul.com, help.chartmogul.com or dev.chartmogul.com.

user_api.notes: The public REST API (dev.chartmogul.com) covers data sources, customers, contacts, CRM objects, plans, subscriptions and metrics; the reference index has no team-member, user or role resource. Team members are managed only in Settings > Admin > Team Members.

google.notes: Sign in with Google is offered (social sign-in, not a SAML app).

fallbacks.notes: Members are added by email invitation only; sign-in is email/password or Sign in with Google. CSV import exists for billing data only; no team-member CSV import is documented.
